test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The ‘flag-raising’ ceremony by the Prime Minister of India on Independence Day is held at which of the following places in Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Red Fort**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On 15 August 1947, the** first Prime Minister of India, Jawaharlal Nehru** r**aised the Indian national flag above the Lahori Gate of the Red Fort in Delhi.**
 
• From August 15, 1947, to 1964, he unfurled the Indian flag at Red Fort for continuous 17 years.​
 
• Every year, the Prime Minister of India unfurls the flag at the Red Fort, but there are some who got a chance to become PM of India but were not able to hoist the flag at the iconic monument.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• List of Prime Ministers who hoisted the flag at Red Fort more than five times:

 
 
• Indira Gandhi - From 1966 to 1977, she got the opportunity for nothing less than 11 times.
 
• Manmohan Singh - Ex-Prime Minister of India unfurled the flag 10 times. 
 
• Narendra Modi - Current Prime Minister of India, Narendra Modi has been hoisting the Indian flag at the Red fort since 2014 till date.
 
• Atal Bihari Vajpayee - He is the only non-Congress Prime Minister who has unfurled the Indian Flag at Red Fort six times.
 
• Rajiv Gandhi and Narasimha Rao unfurled the Indian flag five times each.
